# Tobi Arowosegbe

> Full stack developer, WordPress developer, PHP/Laravel developer, technical SEO specialist, and digital marketer based in Lagos, Nigeria. Available for freelance and contract web development, WordPress, SEO, and digital marketing work.

Tobi Arowosegbe (also known as Tobi Holyprof) has 7+ years of experience building and maintaining websites, fixing WordPress and PHP sites, doing technical SEO, and running digital marketing campaigns for businesses in Nigeria and internationally. He has trained 100+ people in WordPress, frontend development, and digital marketing, and has delivered 200+ websites.
